title: Website Update
text: The latest version of the site is officially live, and this round of updates is all about expanding the library and smoothing out the wrinkles. We’ve rolled out a ton of brand-new content, including dedicated sections for Books and a variety of extra bonus material to dive into. Alongside the new content, the music library just got a massive injection of new tracks. More importantly, we hunted down and squashed a few pesky bugs that were completely blocking certain tracks from playing. The audio pipelines are officially cleared, so you can now enjoy the full soundtrack completely uninterrupted. Moving forward, we are going to be continuously adding to the website over time rather than making you wait months for massive drops. The update is live right now, so head over to the main page, explore the new additions, and blast the music! If you spot any lingering bugs, let us know so we can patch them right out.
